Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports business payments to suppliers, vendors, contractors, and other businesses for commercial transactions, procurement, and supply chain payments.
Comments: B2B payments are supported via bank transfers and PesaLink-enabled business payments (e.g., supplier payments, bulk payments). The World Bank PesaLink case study notes bulk payments use-cases, and merchants/PSPs integrate PesaLink for business payments.

Definition: Whether consumer protection legislation or regulations specifically address digital payment services, covering disclosure requirements, liability allocation for unauthorized transactions, error resolution procedures, and user rights.
Comments: A consumer protection framework exists for payments/DFS via multiple instruments: Kenya’s Consumer Protection Act (2012) provides general consumer rights, and CBK’s Digital Credit Providers Regulations (2022) include consumer protection requirements (complaints mechanisms, disclosure, debt collection conduct, privacy). This indicates a ‘Yes’ consumer protection framework (even if still evolving for some use-cases like fraud reimbursement).

Definition: Whether legal or regulatory requirements obligate payment service providers to notify users, regulators, and/or data protection authorities about payment data breaches, cybersecurity incidents, or unauthorized access within specified timeframes.
Comments: Kenya’s Data Protection Act 2019 (and implementing regulations) provides mandatory breach notification: data controllers must notify the ODPC within 72 hours of becoming aware of a notifiable personal data breach, and data processors must notify controllers within 48 hours.

Definition: Whether national data protection or privacy legislation exists and explicitly covers payment transaction data, including provisions on data collection, storage, sharing, retention, and user rights over their payment data.
Comments: Kenya has general data protection legislation: the Data Protection Act, 2019 applies broadly to personal data processed by payment service providers/fintechs (including financial/transaction data), overseen by the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC). No specific payments-only data law provisions were identified beyond the general framework.
